theme_size.command: bash -c 'n=0; for f in home/dot_config/tinted-theming/tinty/config.toml home/dot_config/tinted-theming/tinty/executable_theme.sh home/dot_config/television/cable/theme.toml home/dot_config/nushell/theme.nu home/dot_config/television/executable_theme-preview.sh home/dot_config/tinted-theming/tinty/executable_tmux-colors.sh; do [ -f "$f" ] && n=$((n+1)); done; l=$(cat home/dot_config/tinted-theming/tinty/config.toml home/dot_config/tinted-theming/tinty/executable_theme.sh home/dot_config/television/cable/theme.toml | wc -l); echo files=$n lines=$l; [ $n -le 4 ] && [ $l -le 200 ]'

manual_fresh.command: bash -c 'd=$(mktemp -d); cp -R home/dot_config/nushell/help/manual "$d"/m; just manual >/dev/null && diff -rq "$d"/m home/dot_config/nushell/help/manual'

scripts_parse.command: bash -c 'rc=0; for f in $(git ls-files home | grep -E "(\.sh$|/executable_)"); do head -1 "$f" | grep -q bash && { bash -n "$f" || { echo "$f"; rc=1; }; }; head -1 "$f" | grep -qE "^#!/bin/sh|env sh" && { sh -n "$f" || { echo "$f"; rc=1; }; }; done; exit $rc'

no_unbounded_wait.command: bash -c 'bad=$(rg -n "nohup|security find-generic-password|pass show" home install.sh --glob "!**/help/**" | grep -v bounded; rg -n "curl " install.sh home --glob "!**/help/**" --glob "!**/Dockerfile" | grep -v -- --max-time); echo "$bad"; [ -z "$bad" ]'

shellcheck.command: bash -c 'rc=0; for f in $(git ls-files home install.sh | grep -E "(\.sh$|/executable_|install\.sh$)"); do head -1 "$f" | grep -qE "bash|/sh" || continue; shellcheck -S warning -f gcc "$f" || rc=1; done; exit $rc'
